page.notes: Hebrew words "חור & עור" and "אור" are transcribed from the scan; the vowel points over the first pair are not clearly legible, so the exact pointing is uncertain. The phrase "qvibusdamRegibus" is printed without a space and is left as printed. The last word "Mahumeti" is split: "Mahu-" ends the text and "meti" is the catchword. Printed u/v were normalised to u as a vowel and v as a consonant, as the rules require.
